title: Flight Compartment Windshield — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of a flight compartment windshield pane, including the heating isolation, the terminal block disconnection sequence and the lifting frame procedure that keeps the pane edge protected.

sections.purpose: This task removes one windshield pane from the flight compartment so that the pane can be replaced, or so that the terminal block and the frame land behind it become accessible.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the aircraft depressurised and on ground power. Windshield heating must be isolated at the circuit breaker and tagged before any terminal is touched, and the pane must be at ambient temperature; a warm pane is more likely to crack at the edge during handling. The lifting frame is mandatory. Two persons are needed for the lift and a third to guide from outside.
sections.procedure: 1. Isolate the windshield heating and tag the circuit breakers. WARNING: THE HEATING TERMINALS CARRY 115 V AC. CONFIRM ZERO VOLTS AT THE TERMINAL BLOCK BEFORE ANY CONNECTION IS BROKEN. 2. Make sure that the pane is at ambient temperature. Do not remove a pane within two hours of a heating cycle. 3. Remove the glareshield and the side console panels in zones 211 and 215 to reach the terminal block. 4. Disconnect the heating harness at the terminal block, taking the earth connection last. 5. Release the cable ties AGS173307-59 that carry the harness tail and stow the harness clear. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE HARNESS TAIL HANG ON ITS TERMINALS. SUPPORT IT. 6. Remove the internal trim and the pressure seal retainer. 7. Fit the lifting frame to the pane and take up the weight from inside. 8. Remove the pane retention fasteners in the sequence on the fastener diagram, working from the centre outwards. 9. With the third person guiding from outside, move the pane inboard and clear, and put it in the transit stand. 10. Do a visual check of the aft spar cap sub-assembly TR874797-15 and the upper stiffener DEL380600-05 for corrosion and for elongated holes. 11. Cover the aperture with the temporary cover.
sections.close_out: Put the removed pane in the transit stand with the outer face protected and record its part number, its position and its total hours if known. Make sure the aperture cover is sealed against weather. Leave the heating circuit breakers tagged until the installation task is complete.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft, all variants; the terminal block position differs pre and post MOD-131880

safety_precautions: Confirm zero volts at the terminal block before any connection is broken.
Do not remove a pane within two hours of a heating cycle.
Use the lifting frame; do not hand-carry the pane.
